_comment: Committed source-of-truth for the md2pdf registry entry (US-CLIREG-MD2PDF-CATALOG-01). The live feed (demo/cli-audit/latest.json) and the registry DB are gitignored generated state, so this entry does NOT travel with git. Apply it on any machine with `sh fleet-clis/md2pdf/seed/apply.sh`. lang=python so the Python adapter emits kind=python_module with script_path, the only launch_spec kind hermes-adapter's _resolve_command can dispatch (a lang=shell entry registers as kind=executable and never reaches the gateway). side_effect writes-fs is DECLARED: the planner keeps a declared writes-fs hop under an empty allow_side_effects (core/planner/search.py _hop_excluded), which is what AC-02 asks for. Path is resolved at apply time — do not hardcode it here.

entries.description: Render a Markdown file to PDF: pandoc -t html5 -s --pdf-engine=weasyprint (no LaTeX; operator ruling 2026-10-30). Usage: md2pdf.py <in.md> [-o <out.pdf>]; default output is <in>.pdf next to the input. Writes the PDF atomically and prints its path. Local, no network.
